scope: Frontend production implementation plus additive FastAPI endpoints listed in runtime/62-frontend-execution-scope.md. Existing backend, migrations, RLS, radar worker, scraper and CRUD factory were preserved.

acceptance_summary.note: The active frontend execution plan supersedes the earlier backend-only count. The active package now contains 86 requirements and 100 acceptance criteria.

frontend_delivered.auth: Supabase Auth only for login/session/reset/update password; all domain data goes through FastAPI with Authorization: Bearer.
frontend_delivered.data_policy: No production mock/static data path. Empty states render when the API returns no rows.
frontend_delivered.states: Loading, error, empty, permission denied, session expired and unavailable paths are implemented through shared boundaries/guards.
frontend_delivered.accessibility: Playwright + Axe passed on authenticated Painel and Contratos routes; protected-route browser coverage passed for all planned list/report pages.

backend_additions: GET /me with active app_members membership response
Pass-through filters/order on existing collection GET routes
JWT aud validation and fail-closed behavior when no verifier is configured
Idempotent PUT /parametros/{ano} upsert for the configuration screen

migrations_created_and_executed.validation: Clean database migration tests remain covered by backend pytest/schema suite and prior baseline evidence; no new schema change was required for the frontend phase.

database_validation.evidence: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:54329/pavageau .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -> 50 passed, including schema, RLS, worker isolation, API persistence and radar tests.

tjce_tjba_pending_behavior.evidence: Unsupported TJCE/TJBA remain registry placeholders and persist as pendente_implementacao; API/frontend represent them as neutral 'Aguardando scraper' and they do not abort radar runs.

notes: No secrets printed in test output or reports.
Frontend uses only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY/PUBLISHABLE_KEY.
Domain data requests attach the user Supabase access token to FastAPI.
Manual radar execution persists through RADAR_DB_URL/radar_worker identity, not service credentials.

performance_findings.frontend: Production build split into small chunks; max gzip chunk 66.77 kB.
performance_findings.backend: Baseline production-like local evidence remains PASS; backend regression suite passed.

deviations.summary: Frontend implementation uses JSX modules instead of TypeScript files named in the idealized architecture.
deviations.impact: No product behavior change. Runtime contracts, validation, tests and build are present; existing repository frontend was already JSX/Vite.

deviations.summary: No new database migration was created in this frontend phase.
deviations.impact: No schema change was needed. All required backend additions were thin API/service additions over existing versioned schema.

external_blockers.summary: Production deployment/provisioning remains operator-owned. Local and Supabase-development validation passed with configured .env credentials.
